accepted_exceptions: universal dodge including movement boost and immunity
current eight-direction firing and existing mouse/keyboard controls

stat_recommendation_review.goal: Port Isaac combat balance, especially bullet range, enemy HP, attack speed, hitboxes and actual kill times, while preserving existing eight-direction mouse/keyboard firing and universal dodge.
stat_recommendation_review.target: Repentance 1.7.9b; ordinary Isaac Normal Basement I comparison
stat_recommendation_review.scope: Recommendations only; no new S gameplay implementation selected. S06 current eight-direction firing/mouse-keyboard controls and S13 universal dodge are accepted retained exceptions.
priority_order: Freeze the current baseline and unit contract
Movement-only calibration and early human acceptance
Coordinated damage/enemy-HP balance and human acceptance
Hitboxes/cover and repeat affected earlier checks
Selected item/stat/slot features, then integrated first-floor acceptance
accepted_control_exceptions: current eight-direction firing and existing mouse/keyboard controls
universal dodge with boost and immunity

implementation_review_gates.name: Freeze the baseline and unit contract
implementation_review_gates.human_check: Play the current controls in the fixed comparison room; agree the camera/zoom, reference distances and baseline feel.
implementation_review_gates.automated_check: Record distance per second, room-crossing time, diagonal speed, dodge distance/duration, firing intervals and current reach. Keep source units, world units, per-invocation values and seconds explicit.
implementation_review_gates.gate: Baseline accepted before replacement movement is integrated.

implementation_review_gates.name: Movement first, with a review after each component
implementation_review_gates.scope: Explicitly selected S04 speed calibration first. S05 is verification-first: no inertia/glide implementation without a measured live-reference difference and its own human review. S14 follows separately when selected.
implementation_review_gates.human_check: Walk straight and diagonally, click to walk, stop/reverse, dodge, fire while moving and rotate the camera. Compare baseline and candidate with identical room, camera and spawn.
implementation_review_gates.automated_check: Compare distance/room fraction per real second, crossing time, acceleration, stopping distance and dodge. Check 30/60/144 render FPS at fixed simulation timing and prevent source/world-scale or 30/60 Hz double application.
implementation_review_gates.gate: User approves movement speed and feel before any dependent projectile/combat rollout.

implementation_review_gates.name: Bullet speed, flight and effective range
implementation_review_gates.scope: Explicitly selected S07, then coherent S08/S09 flight/range work
implementation_review_gates.human_check: Shoot stationary targets at short, medium and maximum range in all eight directions, both standing and moving. Check that shots reach the intended distance and expire where expected.
implementation_review_gates.automated_check: Measure travel time, final reachable distance, logical ground expiry and inherited velocity. Record unavoidable coupling between speed, flight and reach rather than hiding it with an unselected compensation.
implementation_review_gates.gate: User approves travel/reach in the isolated demo before damage balancing is integrated.

implementation_review_gates.name: Attack speed only
implementation_review_gates.scope: Explicitly selected S02; S03 remains a measurement
implementation_review_gates.human_check: Hold and tap mouse/keyboard fire against a stationary target; review cadence, first-shot response and release/repress behavior with existing eight-direction controls.
implementation_review_gates.automated_check: Measure emission intervals and first-shot latency. Keep HP and damage unchanged in this intermediate demo; do not interpret its temporary kill times as the final balance.
implementation_review_gates.gate: User approves firing rhythm and input response.

implementation_review_gates.name: Damage and enemy HP as a coordinated balance change
implementation_review_gates.scope: Explicitly selected S01 plus named enemy/boss HP-only subscopes; S03 verification
implementation_review_gates.human_check: Fight a small fixed roster, then a short room encounter, with the approved movement/range/cadence. Judge shots to kill, encounter length and damage pressure.
implementation_review_gates.automated_check: Use an agreed source-to-DeathWard unit convention; compare discrete hits and actual kill times, source-stage HP, incoming health losses and selected boss vulnerable windows. Do not alter the regular-health multiplier to conceal mismatches.
implementation_review_gates.gate: User approves the small combat set before expanding to the floor roster; no AI/spawn/room redesign is implied.

implementation_review_gates.name: Hitboxes and cover, one rule at a time
implementation_review_gates.scope: Explicitly selected S11/S12/S15; keep rendered art and input mapping separate
implementation_review_gates.human_check: Review obvious hits, edge hits, near misses, walls/cover and targets at different rendered heights. Repeat a short movement check if navigation clearance changes.
implementation_review_gates.automated_check: Compare movement versus damage hulls, projectile radius, terrain occlusion and all eight retained directions. Preserve the previously agreed coordinate scale.
implementation_review_gates.gate: User approves hit fairness; any change to scale, movement or effective projectile timing reopens the relevant earlier review.

implementation_review_gates.name: Selected stat/item interactions and additional slots
implementation_review_gates.scope: Explicitly selected S21; S10 with a real consumer; S22/S23 with their selected content/dependencies
implementation_review_gates.human_check: Review one upgrade or usable item at a time, including acquiring/removing it and moving between rooms/floors.
implementation_review_gates.automated_check: Verify composition/caps, stacking and item-specific behavior. Verify existing S16–S19 defaults without redundant rewrites; treat S20 gameplay changes as item decisions.
